candidates.claim: Telnet is enabled on sw-core-01 vty lines 0 4 (transport input telnet and ssh), which the management policy forbids on every device.
candidates.remediation: Remove telnet from the transport input of line vty 0 4 on sw-core-01 so that only ssh is allowed.

candidates.claim: Line vty 0 4 transport input on sw-core-01 differs from the approved baseline: the baseline allows ssh only, while the current configuration adds telnet.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile sw-core-01 line vty 0 4 with the approved baseline by restoring transport input to ssh only, or record the change as approved.

candidates.claim: Trunk GigabitEthernet1/0/22 on sw-core-01 carries VLAN 10, but the port-role rule says only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10, while the approved trunk list allows {10,99} on this port.
candidates.remediation: Confirm whether this trunk is an authorized OT uplink; if it is not, remove VLAN 10 from its allowed list.

clarifications.question: The registry says only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10, but it also approves sw-core-01 Gi1/0/22 as a trunk carrying {10,99}. Is that trunk an authorized OT uplink, or should VLAN 10 be removed from it?
